note: Word topics, in teaching order. Every word item has exactly one (content/topics/assignments.json, applied by npm run build:topics). Descriptions guide classification.

topics.name: Greetings & Basics
topics.about: greetings, thanks, apologies, yes/no, very first words (こんにちは, すみません, はい)

topics.name: Numbers
topics.about: numbers and numerals (一, 百, 万, 半分 as a number word)

topics.name: Counters
topics.about: counter words and counted forms (〜枚, 〜本, 一つ, 二人, 三日 as a count)

topics.name: Time & Calendar
topics.about: clock time, days, weeks, months, years, dates, seasons as time, before/after in time, schedules (今日, 来週, 午前, 期間, 締め切り)

topics.name: People & Relationships
topics.about: people in general, roles, friends, neighbours, age groups, social relations, love and marriage (人, 友達, 大人, 恋人, 先輩, 相手)

topics.name: Family
topics.about: family members and family life (母, 兄弟, 親戚, 育児)

topics.name: Food & Drink
topics.about: dishes, ingredients, drinks, meals, tastes, eating out (ご飯, 肉, お茶, 甘い, 食事)

topics.name: Fruits & Vegetables
topics.about: fruit, vegetables, grains, edible plants

topics.name: Kitchen & Cooking
topics.about: cooking verbs, kitchen tools and tableware (焼く, 鍋, 皿, 箸, 料理する)

topics.name: Home & Household
topics.about: rooms, furniture, appliances, household goods, chores, housing (部屋, 机, 掃除, 家賃, 引っ越し)

topics.name: Daily Life & Routine
topics.about: everyday actions and routines: wake, sleep, wash, bathe, live, use, carry, put, take (起きる, 寝る, 使う, 置く, 生活)

topics.name: Clothes & Fashion
topics.about: clothing, shoes, accessories, wearing verbs, style (服, 着る, 帽子, 似合う)

topics.name: Body
topics.about: body parts and bodily states that are not illness (頭, 手, 声, 汗, 背)

topics.name: Health & Medicine
topics.about: illness, injury, hospitals, medicine, treatment, fitness, life and death (病気, 薬, 怪我, 治る, 健康)

topics.name: Animals
topics.about: every animal: pets, wild, farm, birds, fish, sea creatures, insects, and animal words (犬, 象, 牛, 鳥, 魚, 虫, 飼う, 鳴く)

topics.name: Nature & Environment
topics.about: landscape, plants and flowers (not food), earth, sky, sea, environment, pollution, natural resources (山, 花, 森, 環境, 資源)

topics.name: Weather & Seasons
topics.about: weather, climate, temperature, seasons, natural disasters (雨, 暑い, 台風, 地震, 季節)

topics.name: Places Around Town
topics.about: buildings, shops, facilities, streets, city and country places, addresses (駅, 銀行, 公園, 道, 町, 郊外)

topics.name: Transportation & Travel
topics.about: vehicles, trips, tourism, luggage, roads and traffic, driving, flights (電車, 旅行, 運転, 渋滞, 乗る)

topics.name: Position & Direction
topics.about: location, direction, distance, inside/outside, order in space (上, 右, 近く, 向こう, 方向, 隣)

topics.name: Movement & Motion
topics.about: going, coming, moving, running, entering, leaving, physical motion verbs (行く, 走る, 入る, 移動, 曲がる, 落ちる)

topics.name: Shopping
topics.about: buying and selling in shops, goods, sales, customers, delivery (買う, 店員, 品物, 割引, 配達)

topics.name: Money & Economy
topics.about: money, prices, payment, banking, economy, finance, trade, industry (お金, 値段, 払う, 経済, 景気, 税金, 輸出)

topics.name: Work & Business
topics.about: jobs, workplaces, companies, meetings, careers, management, contracts (仕事, 会社, 会議, 就職, 担当, 契約)

topics.name: School & Study
topics.about: school, classes, students, teachers, exams, subjects, research, learning (学校, 宿題, 試験, 研究, 学ぶ)

topics.name: Language & Communication
topics.about: speaking, writing, reading, words, letters, phone and mail, conversation, explaining, asking (話す, 言葉, 手紙, 説明, 伝える, 返事)

topics.name: Thinking & Knowledge
topics.about: thinking, knowing, remembering, deciding, opinions, ideas, understanding, memory (思う, 知る, 覚える, 意見, 判断, 理解)

topics.name: Emotions & Feelings
topics.about: feelings, moods, likes and dislikes, wants (嬉しい, 怒る, 好き, 心配, 感動, 寂しい)

topics.name: Personality & Behaviour
topics.about: character traits, attitudes, manners, how people behave (優しい, 真面目, 素直, 我慢, 態度, 礼儀)

topics.name: Hobbies, Sports & Entertainment
topics.about: hobbies, games, sports, music, art, films, events, parties, leisure (趣味, 野球, 映画, 歌う, 祭り, 試合)

topics.name: Technology & Media
topics.about: computers, phones, internet, machines, TV, newspapers, broadcasting, science and engineering (パソコン, 機械, 放送, 記事, 技術, 電気)

topics.name: Objects & Materials
topics.about: everyday objects, tools, stationery, materials and substances not covered elsewhere (鉛筆, 箱, 紙, 鉄, 道具, 袋)

topics.name: Society & Government
topics.about: society, politics, law, rules, police, crime, public services, international affairs, religion, history (社会, 政治, 法律, 警察, 事件, 国際, 戦争)

topics.name: Japanese Culture
topics.about: Japanese traditions, customs, traditional items and arts (着物, 神社, 正月, お辞儀, 茶道)

topics.name: Colors, Shapes & Appearance
topics.about: colours, shapes, looks, how things appear (赤い, 丸い, 形, 美しい, 派手)

topics.name: Size, Amount & Degree
topics.about: size, quantity, number of things, extent, comparison, measurement (大きい, 多い, 少し, 全部, 程度, 量, 増える)

topics.name: Qualities & Conditions
topics.about: general describing words for states and qualities not covered above (新しい, 簡単, 便利, 危ない, 正しい, 特別, 必要)

topics.name: Change, Cause & Result
topics.about: change, cause and effect, beginnings and ends, success and failure, processes (変わる, 原因, 結果, 始まる, 成功, 影響, 続く)

topics.name: Abstract Ideas
topics.about: abstract nouns and concepts that fit no concrete topic (意味, 目的, 関係, 状態, 場合, 方法, 問題, 立場)

topics.name: Adverbs & Manner
topics.about: adverbs of manner, frequency, certainty, timing, onomatopoeia (ゆっくり, きっと, 必ず, よく, もう, ぴったり)

topics.name: Function Words & Pronouns
topics.about: pronouns, demonstratives (これ, あそこ), question words, conjunctions, prefixes and suffixes, grammatical words (でも, それから, 私, 誰, 〜的)

topics.name: Expressions & Set Phrases
topics.about: fixed phrases, idioms and set expressions (お大事に, 仕方がない, 気がつく, いただきます)
